title: Mega-Sena 3060 rolls over and jackpot rises to R$ 32 million
seoTitle: Mega-Sena 3060 Rolls Over to R$ 32 Million
subtitle: No bet matched all six numbers, and the amount will be carried over to the next contest on Tuesday
excerpt: Mega-Sena draw 3060, held this Sunday, had no jackpot winner, causing the prize to roll over to R$ 32 million for the next draw.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The Mega-Sena 3060 draw, held this Sunday (20), had no winning tickets for the six numbers, pushing the jackpot up to R$ 32 million for the next contest. The lack of winners generated high activity at lottery outlets and Caixa's digital channels.

Result of contest 3060

Contest 3060 was drawn at 11 a.m. at Espaço da Sorte in São Paulo and broadcast on Caixa's official channels. The estimated prize for this edition was R$ 28 million, but since no one matched all six numbers, the amount rolled over.

Rollover for the next draw

With the rollover, the next draw, scheduled for Tuesday, September 22, at 9 p.m., will have an estimated prize of R$ 32 million, according to Caixa. The official calendar confirms the date and time.

Quina and quadra prizes

Although the jackpot (sena) was not hit, 54 bets won the quina, taking home R$ 32,111.66 each. In the quadra, 3,075 bets were awarded, receiving R$ 929.52 each.

How to bet and deadlines

The minimum bet costs R$ 6 and can be placed until 8 p.m. on the day of the draw, at any authorized lottery outlet or through Caixa's electronic channels, such as the website, app, and Loterias Online portal. Digital group bets (bolões) can be purchased until 8:30 p.m., exclusively through the same channels. Payment can be made via PIX, credit card, or internet banking for Caixa account holders, and players must be 18 years or older.

Odds of winning

For a single six-number bet, the probability of winning the jackpot is 1 in 50,063,860, according to Caixa. The maximum bet, with 20 numbers, costs R$ 232,560.00 and has odds of 1 in 1,292.

With information from G1, Estadão, ISTOÉ DINHEIRO.
